thread:
leah.sales: Heads up 1 MetroTransit POC is greenlit. Customer asks: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (delta + ability to do a one-time bulk import), domain verification for three subdomains (they want delegated verification), group->role mapping, and strict key management (FIPS KMS) for logs/encryption. They want to start on Hosted for evaluation and move to Dedicated in Q3. Pricing/migration ask: what's typical uplift and what migration support do we include?

Tom.id: Quick SAML/SCIM bullets: 
- SAML: we provide an SP metadata XML and support both SP- and IdP-initiated flows. We support AssertionConsumerService + SingleLogout endpoints.
- SCIM: delta PATCH/PUT supported. One-time bulk import via POST /scim/v2/Bulk-Import (CSV or JSON). We surface provisioning audit events to the audit log.

Tom.id: SP snippet for their Okta admin to consume:
```
ACS: https://inference.redwood.com/saml/acs
EntityID: https://inference.redwood.com/saml/metadata
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress
WantAssertionsSigned: true
```

sam.se: SCIM rate limits: Hosted default 50 req/min. For Dedicated we can provision higher limits (configurable) and offer a reserved window for the initial bulk import. We also support exponential backoff and a resumable import token for large datasets. Default SCIM attrs we accept: userName, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work], active, roles (groups), externalId.

nina.sec: Security checklist they will request: SOC2, ISO27001 summary, pen test report, encryption-in-transit+at-rest, and KMS options. Note: for FIPS KMS we require Private deployment or an enterprise Dedicated zone with customer-managed keys. Also we can enable mutual TLS for SCIM if they require client certs.

nina.sec: SAML/session defaults: Assertion lifetime default 2 minutes, session cookie TTL 8 hours; both configurable. We should ask if they need shortened sessions or persistent SSO exceptions.

leah.sales: Pricing/migration guidance for contracts: 
- Hosted: self-serve usage billing. Fast onboarding, no infra commit.
- Dedicated: reserved capacity with committed throughput; uplift typically ~2x hosted equivalent based on steady-state reserved pricing. Discounting depends on term (1/2/3 year).
- Migration: we include a migration playbook and 12 hours of SE assistance for mid-market POCs; full enterprise migrations (including Private/FIPS) are scoped as PS and estimated separately.

leah.sales: Additional asks from MetroTransit: Do they need IdP certificate fingerprint or metadata file? They also want guidance on nested group handling in Okta and whether transitive group membership is applied.

Tom.id: Confirm nested groups: we support transitive membership mapping but performance can degrade if group graphs exceed ~200k edges; recommend flattening or scheduled sync windows for very large orgs.

sam.se: Action items: 
1) I'll send the SP metadata file to the customer Okta admin and include the bulk-import endpoint docs.
2) Tom: prepare a sample SCIM mapping CSV and a sample PATCH payload for delta sync.
3) Nina: prepare SOC2/pen-test stub and note about FIPS KMS for Private.
4) Leah: I'll draft a small pricing compare table (Hosted vs Dedicated) and include a 3-month migration timeline example.

bot-scheduler: Reminder: POC kickoff meeting scheduled Monday 09:00 PT (calendar invite with dial-in sent).

leah.sales: Thanks. @sam.se please drop the SCIM sample today. @nina.sec let's aim for a 1-hour sync before kickoff if possible. :thumbsup:
